%% Calibration deck: footnotes in revealed content appear with that content (v10.12.0), on six steps: after a
%% \pause, in an \item<3->, in \onslide<4->{...}, \uncover<5->{...} and \visible<6->{...}. A footnote outside
%% revealed content shows on every step, one with its own specification keeps it. Each footnote's text starts
%% with a word tests/test_revealed_footnotes.py looks for.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Footnotes in revealed content}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item Shown at once\footnote{Fnalways: outside revealed content, on every step.}
		\item With a specification of its own\footnote<2->{Fnown: from step 2, as its own specification says.}
		\pause
		\item After a pause\footnote{Fnpause: with the item after the pause, from step 2.}
		\item<3-> Revealed by the item's specification\footnote{Fnitem: with this item, from step 3.}
	\end{itemize}
	\onslide<4->{Onslide\footnote{Fnonslide: with the onslide content, from step 4.}},
	\uncover<5->{uncover\footnote{Fnuncover: with the uncovered content, from step 5.}} and
	\visible<6->{visible\footnote{Fnvisible: with the visible content, from step 6.}}
\end{standardframe}
